source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Using the chosen layout, players agree which of the battlefield’s edges match the Attacker’s and Defender’s edges marked on the card. The roll-off winner then picks who is Attacker and who is Defender.

detail.agree: which battlefield edges match the Attacker's and Defender's edges labelled on the card
detail.assignment: winner chooses who is Attacker and who is Defender
